title: Spooky Music Bingo
shortDescription: Halloween-season songs, familiar favorites, and Music Bingo with your friends at WesCo.
description: It’s spooky season at WesCo Brew & Bowl. Grab your friends for Spooky Music Bingo, packed with Halloween-season songs, familiar favorites, and those tunes everyone knows. Listen, mark your card, and enjoy a Tuesday night together in Cayce.
instructions: Contact WesCo for seating or participation details. Music Bingo starts at 7:00 PM.
